title: 库存与物品管理繁琐
description: 库存和物品管理操作繁琐，包括物品不堆叠、搬运效率低、存储不便、物品丢失等，增加玩家负担。
evidence: seems VERY micromanagement heavy though, especially inventory management
my character will deliver the materials [b]one at a time[/b], despite correctly using the cart when I explicitly tell him to haul.

evidence_items.quote: As tarefas de hauling não são nada eficientes, quase nunca faz sentido usar elas. Por exemplo, se você quer transportar 50x pisos de uma nave sucata para dentro da sua, os tripulantes vão pegar 5x-10x pisos por vez ao invés de encher seu inventário.
evidence_items.description: 搬运任务效率低下，船员一次只搬运少量物品，且没有“全部拾取”命令。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 搬运任务一点也不高效，几乎从来都不值得用它们。例如，如果你想从一艘废船上把50x地板运到你的船里，船员们会一次只拿5x-10x地板，而不是装满自己的物品栏。

evidence_items.quote: There are several times where I intentionally "dropped" a dolly (essentially a large shopping cart) and coudn't pick it back up.
evidence_items.description: 故意放下手推车后无法重新拾起，游戏未给出原因
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有好几次我故意“丢下”一辆推车（基本上就是一个大型购物车），却没法再把它捡起来。

evidence_items.quote: the character takes one. piece. at. a. time. back. and. forth. forever.
evidence_items.description: 安装任务时角色一次只搬一个部件来回跑，效率极低
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色会一次。一。件。地。来。回。跑。个。没。完。

evidence_items.quote: Characters swapping batteries in devices or EVA suits tend to dump stuff on the floor.
evidence_items.description: 角色换电池或EVA服时把物品丢在地上
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色在设备或EVA服中更换电池时，往往会把东西丢在地上。

evidence_items.quote: Water is the same: no plumbing; you still haul bottles to sinks.
evidence_items.description: 水系统无管道，仍需手动搬运瓶子到水槽
evidence_items.quote_zh: 水也是一样：没有管道；你还是得把水桶搬到水槽边。

evidence_items.quote: Your items don't get registered properly
evidence_items.description: 物品未正确注册
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的物品无法被正确登记

evidence_items.quote: refuses to stack items in bags and just goes one by one
evidence_items.description: 拒绝堆叠物品，逐个处理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 拒绝把物品堆叠进包里，只是一件一件地来

evidence_items.quote: storage has to all be done manually
evidence_items.description: 存储必须手动完成
evidence_items.quote_zh: 储物必须全部手动完成

evidence_items.quote: The logic involved in hauling anything you strip off a derelict is terrible.
evidence_items.description: 搬运物品的逻辑很差，角色不会使用背包或手推车，一次只搬一个地砖。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 搬运你从废弃船上拆下来的任何东西所涉及的逻辑都糟透了。

evidence_items.quote: The logic for transporting items to construction is terrible.
evidence_items.description: 将物品运输到建造地点的逻辑也很糟糕。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 把物品运送到建造处的逻辑糟透了。

evidence_items.quote: Everything in this game is cumbersome just for the sake of it.
evidence_items.description: 游戏中的一切都只是为了繁琐而繁琐。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这游戏里的一切都只是为了折腾而折腾。

evidence_items.quote: The management system itself is clunky and poorly implemented.
evidence_items.description: 船员管理系统笨拙且实现不佳。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 管理系统本身既笨重又实现得很差。

evidence_items.quote: Once a crewmember swaps a battery, they just drop it on the ground instead of storing it.
evidence_items.description: 船员更换电池后将其丢在地上而不是存放。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一旦船员更换了电池，他们就直接把它扔在地上，而不是把它收好。

evidence_items.quote: There are multiple cartriges that you are supposed to be able to slot in. Two slots only though. But over 5 cards. So you are stuck constantly switching around
evidence_items.description: PDA只有两个卡槽但有多张卡，需要频繁切换
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有多个卡带，按理说你应该能把它们插进去。但只有两个插槽。却有超过5张卡。所以你只能不停地来回切换

evidence_items.quote: Система хранения лута сделана максимально неудобно, из-за чего менеджмент вещей превращается в бесконечную рутину
evidence_items.description: 存储系统不便，物品管理繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战利品存储系统做得极其不方便，导致物品管理变成无休止的例行公事

evidence_items.quote: some items can get damaged by uninstalling (like transponders) so clearly I need to prepare more and uninstall it more care- nope, its just rng, you just save scum it.
evidence_items.description: 卸载物品的损坏完全随机，只能靠存档读档
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些物品在卸载时可能会损坏（比如应答器），所以显然我需要做更多准备，更小心地卸载它——不，这只是随机数，你只要存档读档就行了。

evidence_items.quote: Characters still can't replace batteries in tools without dropping flat batteries on the ground instead of properly inserting them into chargers
evidence_items.description: 角色更换工具电池时会把旧电池丢在地上而不是放入充电器
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色仍然无法更换工具中的电池，他们会把没电的电池扔在地上，而不是正确地插入充电器

evidence_items.quote: During auto-repairs, crew members carry loose parts one by one instead of using their backpacks.
evidence_items.description: 自动修理时船员逐个搬运松散零件而不用背包
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在自动维修期间，船员们会一件一件地搬运散落的零件，而不是使用他们的背包。

evidence_items.quote: terrible hauling in a game mostly about hauling
evidence_items.description: 搬运系统体验很差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在一个主要关于搬运的游戏中，搬运体验却糟透了

evidence_items.quote: Customising the startership feels great early game but is a slog for torch drive rooms, watching my guy for 10min at max speed just drag floors and walls around.
evidence_items.description: 游戏内飞船编辑器操作繁琐，需要长时间手动拖拽
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在游戏早期自定义初始飞船感觉很棒，但到了热核驱动舱室就成了一件苦差事，看着我的角色以最高速度花10分钟只是把地板和墙壁拖来拖去。

evidence_items.quote: If you give the command Haul restricted to electrical things, the wall gets hauled in the elettrical zone of your hangar too
evidence_items.description: 限制为电气物品的搬运指令会把带电力管道的墙也搬进电气区
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你下达限制为电气物品的搬运命令，那面墙也会被搬运到你机库的电气区域

evidence_items.quote: the uninstalling, installing and fixing can drag on
evidence_items.description: 卸载、安装和修理过程拖沓
evidence_items.quote_zh: 卸载、安装和修理可能会拖得很长

evidence_items.quote: Lack of advanced hauling/bartering zone controls to let you specify exactly where items should be stored
evidence_items.description: 缺乏高级搬运/交易区域控制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 缺乏高级的搬运/交易区控制，无法让你精确指定物品应该存放在哪里

evidence_items.quote: QOL is literally not present.
evidence_items.description: 库存管理缺乏生活质量功能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 生活质量功能压根就不存在。

evidence_items.quote: the pda tasks are dumb (they grab items one by one back and forth)
evidence_items.description: PDA任务愚蠢，逐个来回搬运物品
evidence_items.quote_zh: pda任务很蠢（他们一件一件地来回搬运物品）

evidence_items.quote: the scale of it is so massive that, in the early game—when you can't afford big ships—it’s just absurd.
evidence_items.description: 早期游戏搬运打捞组件的规模过大，不合理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它的规模如此庞大，以至于在游戏前期——当你买不起大船的时候——简直荒谬。

evidence_items.quote: my character will deliver the materials [b]one at a time[/b], despite correctly using the cart when I explicitly tell him to haul.
evidence_items.description: 角色搬运材料时一次只搬一个，即使有手推车
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我的角色会[b]一次一件[/b]地运送材料，尽管当我明确告诉他去搬运时，他会正确地使用推车。

evidence_items.quote: most items that can stack will not do so if the durability is not the same (a 80% floor doesn't stack with an 81% floor)
evidence_items.description: 耐久度不同的物品无法堆叠
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大多数可以堆叠的物品如果耐久度不同就不会堆叠（一个80%的地板不会和一个81%的地板堆叠）

evidence_items.quote: systems that were implemented to help with it are working so atrociously bad, they are almost unusable
evidence_items.description: 用于帮助整理的系统的运作极差，几乎不可用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 那些为了实现这个而加入的系统运行得糟糕透顶，几乎没法用

evidence_items.quote: you WILL know the dysphoric hell of constantly, manually sorting every single piece of trash, absolutely everywhere
evidence_items.description: 需要不断手动整理各处垃圾
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你一定会体会到那种烦躁的地狱，就是不停地手动整理每一件垃圾，到处都是

evidence_items.quote: Nobody should be carrying around two backpacks (one in each hand) and micromanaging dozens of inventory things.
evidence_items.description: 背包和物品管理繁琐，需要双手各拿一个背包并翻找物品
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不应该有人随身带着两个背包（每只手一个），还要微观管理几十件物品栏里的东西。

evidence_items.quote: The inventory and container system is also overly complicated to make it look like you need to manage it. In reality you can put a crowbar into your trousers pocket, scraps into a lamp,... everything is only taking one slot and not stackable, making sure you turn every containers into a pile of ♥♥♥♥.
evidence_items.description: 物品栏和容器系统过于复杂，物品不堆叠且各占一格，容器很快堆满
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏和容器系统也过于复杂，搞得好像你需要去管理它似的。实际上你可以把撬棍塞进裤子口袋，把废料塞进灯里……所有东西都只占一个格子而且不能堆叠，保证让你把每个容器都变成一堆♥♥♥♥。

evidence_items.quote: seems VERY micromanagement heavy though, especially inventory management
evidence_items.description: 库存管理过于繁琐，微操负担重
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不过看起来非常偏重微观管理，尤其是物品栏管理

evidence_items.quote: pawns control system is not really working (hauling one by one seriously)
evidence_items.description: 小人控制系统不工作，搬运只能一个一个来
evidence_items.quote_zh: 小人控制系统实际上根本不好用（居然一个一个地搬运）

evidence_items.quote: inventory management is badly designed
evidence_items.description: 物品栏管理设计糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏管理设计得很糟糕

evidence_items.quote: Your suit can only have two slots. The bare minimum you'll need for your tools is three.
evidence_items.description: 太空服只有两个槽位，无法满足基本需求
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的宇航服只能有两个槽位。而你放工具所需的最低限度是三个。

evidence_items.quote: Inventory management is a complete nightmare first and foremost, with the very concept of organization being a mortal enemy of the devs. Imagine if you had a book case. But Despite being as all as you, that case only has three shelves. And only one book can be put on each shelf. This is literally how the inventory system in the game works.
evidence_items.description: 库存系统槽位过少，不合理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏管理首先就是一个彻头彻尾的噩梦，组织整理这个概念本身就是开发者的死敌。想象一下你有一个书柜。但尽管它和你一样高，那个柜子却只有三层架子。而且每层架子上只能放一本书。这字面意义上就是游戏里物品栏系统的运作方式。

evidence_items.quote: Slowly dragging one oxygen canister at a time through half a space station to sell it in a shop is a too realistic
evidence_items.description: 游戏过于硬核，搬运氧气罐等操作过于真实繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一次一个氧气罐，慢慢拖着穿过半个空间站，再把它卖到商店里，这太真实了

evidence_items.quote: left & right shoes are treated as separate entities instead of being bundled together
evidence_items.description: 左右鞋被当作独立实体，增加无意义点击
evidence_items.quote_zh: 左鞋和右鞋被当作独立的实体，而不是捆绑在一起

evidence_items.quote: I left items outside of the ship during a derelict run and when I docked at the station all the items were still where I left them but had somehow traveled half way across the star system without being in a cargoweb?
evidence_items.description: 可以通过不建造货网来利用系统漏洞，物品会跟随飞船移动
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我在一次废弃飞船打捞行动中把物品留在了飞船外面，当我在空间站停靠时，所有物品都还在我留下的地方，但它们不知怎么地在没有货网的情况下穿越了半个星系？

evidence_items.quote: couldnt place a battery charger
evidence_items.description: 无法放置电池充电器
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没法放置电池充电器

evidence_items.quote: spend 2 hours scrapping a derilect jsut to get back to the station and the crap vendor wont buy your scrap
evidence_items.description: 打捞两小时后返回空间站，商人却不肯收购废料
evidence_items.quote_zh: 花2个小时拆解一艘废弃飞船，结果回到空间站，那个垃圾商人却不肯买你的废料

evidence_items.quote: when canceling a task to force a start over since she won't work, the battery just disappears!
evidence_items.description: 取消任务后电池消失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当取消任务以强制重新开始，因为她不肯工作时，电池就直接消失了！

evidence_items.quote: I don't recommend hiring NPC crew, as you have to micro manage -almost- everything they do
evidence_items.description: 雇佣NPC船员需要事无巨细地管理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我不推荐雇佣NPC船员，因为你几乎得微观管理他们做的每一件事

evidence_items.quote: if a zone ends near a corner tile, there is a chance that your character will infinitely stack items on top of a wall tile
evidence_items.description: 区域靠近角落时角色可能无限堆叠物品在墙砖上
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果一个区域在某个角落格子附近结束，你的角色就有可能无限地把物品堆叠到某个墙格上

evidence_items.quote: there is no automation of transferring gasses between canisters
evidence_items.description: 没有在罐体之间转移气体的自动化功能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有在罐子之间转移气体的自动化功能

evidence_items.quote: The uninstall is boring slow/tedious.
evidence_items.description: 卸载过程无聊、缓慢且繁琐。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 卸载过程无聊、缓慢/乏味。

evidence_items.quote: if I'm close to a wall, the items spawn outside the ship and cannot be retrieved if you are docked at a station
evidence_items.description: 在船内拆解物品时，物品可能生成到船外且无法取回
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果我靠近墙壁，物品会生成在飞船外面，而且如果你停靠在空间站，就无法取回它们

evidence_items.quote: the auto build not being able to find the parts when you took the time to place them in neat little stacks right next to the build site
evidence_items.description: 自动建造无法找到已放置的零件
evidence_items.quote_zh: 自动建造在你花时间把零件整整齐齐地堆放在建造点旁边时却找不到它们

evidence_items.quote: not being able to tell your guy to auto build using specific materials, instead they will grab anything
evidence_items.description: 无法指定自动建造使用特定材料，角色会抓取任何材料
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没法让你的人用特定材料自动建造，他们反而会随便抓任何东西

evidence_items.quote: when I send my character to uninstall large amounts of things they uninstall and drop them on the floor even if there is space in my inventory
evidence_items.description: 卸载大量物品时即使背包有空间也会掉在地上
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当我派我的角色去拆卸大量物品时，即使我的库存里还有空间，他们也会把拆下来的东西丢在地上

evidence_items.quote: extremely granular inventory management
evidence_items.description: 物品栏管理极其繁琐。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 极其细致的物品栏管理

evidence_items.quote: the main difficulty of the game is essentially remembering where you stored something. This makes building and repair with spare parts tedious
evidence_items.description: 存储机制导致建造和修理时寻找零件非常繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏的主要难点基本上就是记住你把某样东西存放在哪里。这让用备用零件进行建造和修理变得很繁琐。

evidence_items.quote: the salvaging and building system is a slog, you cannot mass deconstruct then plan a build on the parts you've selected to deconstruct
evidence_items.description: 打捞和建造系统繁琐，无法批量拆解后规划建造
evidence_items.quote_zh: 打捞和建造系统很磨人，你不能批量拆解，然后根据你选中要拆解的部件来规划建造

evidence_items.quote: sometimes items will just disappear
evidence_items.description: 物品会消失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有时物品会直接消失

evidence_items.quote: Uninstalling parts in your ship and they appear outside the ship... serious issue as there is no way to go outside?
evidence_items.description: 卸载飞船部件后部件出现在飞船外，且无法出去
evidence_items.quote_zh: 从你的飞船中卸载部件，它们却出现在飞船外面……严重问题，因为根本没有办法出去？

evidence_items.quote: items disapearing
evidence_items.description: 物品消失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品消失。

evidence_items.quote: Half of the scrap that I got I couldn't sell for some reason
evidence_items.description: 部分废料无法出售
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我捡到的废料有一半因为某些原因卖不掉

evidence_items.quote: randomly thing you need that may be available like a crowbar is easily available but on the next play through it's locked behind dead doors
evidence_items.description: 物品可用性不一致，例如撬棍有时容易获得，有时被锁在门后
evidence_items.quote_zh: 随机出现你需要的、可能可用的东西，比如一根撬棍很容易拿到，但下一次游玩时它就被锁在打不开的门后面了

evidence_items.quote: Previously you could carry stacks of five floors/walls. Now you can only drag one.
evidence_items.description: 现在只能一次拖动一个物品，而以前可以携带五层堆叠。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 以前你可以搬运五层地板/墙壁的堆叠。现在你只能拖动一个。

evidence_items.quote: The new mechanics make building your ship a chore and no longer fun.
evidence_items.description: 新的库存系统使建造飞船变得繁琐，不再有趣。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 新的机制让建造你的飞船变成了一件苦差事，不再有趣。

evidence_items.quote: Fix possibility to navigate ship without dropping carried large item. Otherwise it is possible to pick large object and having no space at ship fly away with it.
evidence_items.description: 可以在携带大型物品的情况下驾驶飞船，导致物品可能被带走。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 修复在不丢下携带的大型物品的情况下驾驶飞船的可能性。否则就可能捡起大型物体，而船上没有空间，却带着它飞走。

evidence_items.quote: even accessing items that in a storage compartment is so complex as to be unplayable
evidence_items.description: 访问储物格中的物品过于复杂，几乎无法游玩
evidence_items.quote_zh: 就连访问储物格里的物品都复杂到无法游玩

evidence_items.quote: You sorta have to cut the ship apart and sell it in pieces that fit in your little dinghy all while paying a huge mortgage on that boat four times a day.
evidence_items.description: 只能把船拆成小块装进小船出售，无法直接出售整船
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你有点不得不把船拆开，把碎片卖掉，这些碎片还得能装进你的小艇里，同时每天还要为那艘船支付四次巨额贷款。

evidence_items.quote: inventory management is tough to do since you can't carry large parts
evidence_items.description: 库存管理困难，无法携带大型部件，只能拖拽，操作耗时费力
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏管理很难做，因为你无法携带大型部件

evidence_items.quote: Sometimes when uninstalling something, the item will disapear. Which can be devastating.
evidence_items.description: 卸载物品时，物品有时会消失，造成损失。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有时在卸载某样东西时，物品会消失。这可能造成毁灭性后果。

evidence_items.quote: Yeah you can jettison stuff.... one at a time.... 100s of trash.... ugh
evidence_items.description: 只能一次丢弃一个物品，处理大量垃圾很麻烦
evidence_items.quote_zh: 是啊，你可以抛弃东西……一次一个……几百件垃圾……唉

evidence_items.quote: the only thing not on it I'd like to see would be a more direct hand in actually breaking down ship systems on wrecks (More active shipbreaking)
evidence_items.description: 希望更直接地参与拆解飞船系统，目前缺乏主动拆解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 唯一不在上面而我希望看到的，是能更直接地亲手拆解残骸上的飞船系统（更主动的拆船）

evidence_items.quote: I just didn't want to go through the slog of moving all of my ship parts over bit by bit
evidence_items.description: 逐件转移飞船部件的过程非常繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我只是不想经历一点一点把我所有飞船部件搬过去的苦差事

evidence_items.quote: stuffs you can't remove
evidence_items.description: 有些东西无法移除
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你无法移除的东西

evidence_items.quote: items that you lose for no good reason
evidence_items.description: 物品无故丢失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你会毫无正当理由失去的物品

evidence_items.quote: disappearing battery
evidence_items.description: 电池消失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 电池消失

evidence_items.quote: was bothered that I couldn't carry everything I bought at the trader station so it just left my items on the ground rather than bringing them to my ship.
evidence_items.description: 无法携带所有购买的物品，物品被留在地上而非带到飞船
evidence_items.quote_zh: 很烦恼我无法携带在贸易站买的所有东西，所以它只是把我的物品留在地上，而不是把它们带到我的飞船上。

player_themes.title: PDA任务愚蠢，逐个来回搬运物品

evidence_items.quote: the pda tasks are dumb (they grab items one by one back and forth)
evidence_items.description: PDA任务愚蠢，逐个来回搬运物品
evidence_items.quote_zh: pda任务很蠢（他们一件一件地来回搬运物品）

player_themes.title: PDA只有两个卡槽但有多张卡，需要频繁切换

evidence_items.quote: There are multiple cartriges that you are supposed to be able to slot in. Two slots only though. But over 5 cards. So you are stuck constantly switching around
evidence_items.description: PDA只有两个卡槽但有多张卡，需要频繁切换
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有多个卡带，按理说你应该能把它们插进去。但只有两个插槽。却有超过5张卡。所以你只能不停地来回切换

player_themes.title: 区域靠近角落时角色可能无限堆叠物品在墙砖上

evidence_items.quote: if a zone ends near a corner tile, there is a chance that your character will infinitely stack items on top of a wall tile
evidence_items.description: 区域靠近角落时角色可能无限堆叠物品在墙砖上
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果一个区域在某个角落格子附近结束，你的角色就有可能无限地把物品堆叠到某个墙格上
